ev.q: In 2021, the U.S. age-adjusted drug overdose death rate involving cocaine was 7.3 deaths per 100,000 standard population.
The highest rate was in Region 1 (14.8)
In 2021, the U.S. age-adjusted drug overdose death rate involving cocaine was 7.3 deaths per 100,000 standard population.
The highest rate was in Region 1 (14.8)
The lowest rate was in Region 10 (2.3)
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data, 2021.

methods_quotes.q: Age-adjusted drug overdose death rates were calculated using the direct method and the 2000 U.S. population.
Drug overdose deaths involving cocaine were identified using International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision underlying cause-of-death codes X40–X44, X60–X64, X85, and Y10–Y14
